object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. Only test_set_figure_relative_path_resolves_against_repo_root sets the working directory. The other two rely on pytest running from a folder other than the temporary repository, which always holds.
object.description: Set the server's working directory to a folder other than the repository's root folder. Call set_figure with a source_path relative to the root, export_document with out_path out/report.pdf, and commit_changes with paths naming one object file relative to the root. Expected: the figure is read from under the root, the PDF is written to out/report.pdf under the root, and the commit holds the named file.
